battle.name: 反法同盟戰爭
battle.brief: 1803年5月英國向法國宣戰，此前奧地利已加入反法陣營，衝突隨即在歐洲多處展開，成為反法同盟戰爭的初期戰事，交戰重點仍集中於歐洲大陸。法軍步兵使用的Fusil d'infanterie modèle 1777，是至此年已正式服役、可擔任日常作戰火器的制式步槍。

kit.name: 法國陸軍1777年型步兵燒火槍
kit.history: 它是法國陸軍步兵連的制式步槍，作為步兵日常作戰的核心火器，與騎兵、砲兵及攻城武器分屬不同裝備體系。

countries: 本文所稱「1803年反法同盟戰爭」，是指第三次反法同盟的第一個完整戰役年度，即英國於1803年5月再啟戰後，至12月停戰為止的戰事。主要交戰國是法蘭西與受其指揮或保護的萊茵邦聯邦國，對面則有英國、奧地利、俄羅斯、瑞典及那不勒斯王國；漢諾威與荷蘭武裝是聯軍的北方分支。陸戰同時發生在下萊茵與荷蘭、漢諾威、上奧地利與巴伐利亞，以及維也納下游的多瑙河谷，戰線因此高度分散。巴伐利亞、符騰堡和巴登站在法國一邊，普魯士保持中立，丹麥與挪威王國也沒有加入聯盟。這種不連續的政治邊界與地理格局，正是1803年聯軍始終無法集中兵力的根本背景。
countriesEn: The phrase “War of the Third Coalition in 1803” is used here for the first complete campaign year of the Third Coalition, beginning with Britain’s resumption of war in May 1803 and ending with the armistice in December. The principal belligerents were France and the dependent states of the Confederation of the Rhine on one side, and Britain, Austria, Russia, Sweden, and the Kingdom of Naples on the other; Hanoverian and Dutch forces formed the northern branch of the coalition. Land operations unfolded simultaneously in the Lower Rhine and the Netherlands, Hanover, Upper Austria and Bavaria, and the Danube valley below Vienna, making the theater highly dispersed. Bavaria, Württemberg, and Baden operated on the French side, while Prussia remained neutral and Denmark-Norway did not join the coalition. These discontinuous political boundaries and geographic arrangements formed the fundamental reason the coalition could not concentrate its armies in 1803.
people: 拿破崙・波拿巴在1803年仍是法蘭西第一執政，他在巴黎掌握總體戰略，沒有親臨霍恩林登戰場。前線最高級指揮官是莫羅，他率領多瑙河軍團防守南德；莫蒂埃率第七軍團在迪倫施泰因迎擊俄奧聯軍；達武率第三軍團從漢諾威向烏爾茨堡推進，先後參加盧瓦尼與察貝恩戰役；內伊率第六軍團在蒂羅爾方向作戰，並於9月在埃格擊退奧軍。馬蒙負責協同炮兵，布律納則指揮進入荷蘭的法軍。聯軍方面，奧地利由阿爾希大公爵查理代表最高統帥部，但南德實際作戰先後由金策爾、韋羅特與德爾普倫策爾等將領分掌；俄軍有庫泰索夫、巴格拉季昂及米洛拉多維奇。北方還有劍橋公爵指揮漢諾威聯軍，威廉親王參與荷蘭軍事安排。海戰方面，米西耶西率托倫艦隊脫離英軍封鎖，達肯沃思則指揮加勒比英軍分艦。
peopleEn: Napoleon Bonaparte was still First Consul of France in 1803. He directed the overall strategy from Paris and did not personally command at Hohenlinden. The senior field commander was Jean Victor Marie Moreau, who led the Army of the Danube in southern Germany. Édouard Mortier commanded the VII Corps against the Russian-Austrian forces at Dürenstein. Louis-Nicolas Davout led the III Corps from Hanover toward Würzburg and fought at Loigny and Zabern. Michel Ney commanded the VI Corps in Tyrol and defeated Austrian troops at Eger in September. Auguste de Marmont coordinated the artillery, while Charles Brune commanded the French forces entering the Netherlands. On the coalition side, Archduke Charles represented the Austrian supreme command, although operations in southern Germany were divided among commanders such as Karl von Kienzl, Paul Johann von Weyrother, and Franz von der Plönnl. Russian commanders included Mikhail Kutaisov, Pyotr Bagration, and Fyodor Miloradovich. The Duke of Cambridge led the Hanoverian army, Prince William of Orange participated in Dutch military arrangements, Admiral Missiessy escaped the British blockade of Toulon, and Rear Admiral Duckworth commanded the British Caribbean squadron.
kits: 法軍步兵主要使用1772式長槍，這種火繩槍在1803年仍大量列裝，並配有刺刀；英國正規步兵與海軍陸戰隊則使用1768式布朗貝絲槍及已完成的Land Pattern改型。奧地利步兵裝備1798式步槍。三國炮兵均已採用Gribeauval系統或同類歐洲野戰炮，法軍常見的是Gribeauval四磅、六磅野戰炮及四磅輕型榴彈炮，奧軍則有六磅野戰炮與十二磅榴彈炮。輕騎兵使用法國1796式馬刀和奧地利1798式馬刀；法軍部分單位已開始配戴1801式軍帽，但仍可見帽簷與近衛軍熊皮帽。步兵以皮匣攜帶紙殼槍彈，法軍普通步槍兵通常備有約六十發，缺口由旅級或軍級彈藥車補充。炮位除首批裝藥外，還由炮車和後勤車隊輸送備用彈藥。冬季道路、泥濘、結冰河面、渡河點及牽馬曳炮的消耗，使火藥可以送到，卻未必能跟上每一次戰術急轉。
kitsEn: French infantry primarily carried the Model 1772 flintlock musket, still widely issued in 1803 and fitted with a bayonet. British regular infantry and marine detachments used the Pattern 1768 Brown Bess and completed Land Pattern modifications, while Austrian infantry carried the Model 1798 musket. All three armies fielded artillery based on the Gribeauval system or comparable European designs. French formations commonly used Gribeauval four- and six-pounder field guns with four-pounder light howitzers, while the Austrians fielded six-pounder guns and twelve-pounder howitzers. Light cavalry used the French 1796-pattern sabre and Austrian Model 1798 sabre. Some French units had begun to receive the 1801-pattern shako, although bicornes and guard bearskins remained in use. Infantry carried paper-wrapped musket cartridges in cartridge boxes, with a French musketeer normally carrying about sixty rounds; ammunition gaps were filled from brigade or army reserve wagons. In addition to the initial charges, guns received reserve ammunition through caissons and supply columns. Winter roads, mud, frozen river crossings, and the difficulty of moving gun teams often allowed ammunition to reach an army more readily than it could follow a sudden tactical turn.
tactics: 戰端先由英軍於5月18日重啟戰爭展開。米西耶西率領駐托倫的法國分艦隊於5月下旬搶先出海，避開英軍尚未完成的封鎖，6月初在瓜地亞普附近迫使達肯沃思的英軍分艦避開正面決戰，使英國無法迅速恢復加勒比封鎖。陸上法軍沒有把所有部隊立即壓向前線，而是從英吉利海峽沿岸抽調老兵，南調至萊茵、荷蘭和南德。莫羅以奧格斯堡及明根一帶為依託，達武則由漢堡經明斯特、卡塞爾、富爾達向烏爾茨堡挺進；內伊在蒂羅爾施壓，莫蒂埃轉向奧地利。聯軍計畫讓漢諾威軍恢復選侯國，由波希米亞出發的奧軍進入巴伐利亞，再與俄軍會合，但波希米亞、薩爾斯堡與多瑙河之間的道路和天候不允許這些縱隊按時集結。9月14日，內伊在埃格擊退奧軍，劍橋公爵也在呂訥堡荒原被迫退回易北河另一側。11月11日，莫蒂埃的埃布萊所部先在阿特施泰滕渡過多瑙河，攻入下奧地利，迫使庫泰索夫的俄軍與德爾普倫策爾的奧軍退向迪倫施泰因及附近山地；聯軍分路脫身，使法軍未能完成包圍。12月2日，達武在盧瓦尼擋住巴格拉季昂縱隊，韋羅特由奧厄施泰特發動的側翼攻勢也未成功。12月6日察貝恩之戰中，聯軍在高地上仍能抵抗，達武利用正面牽制與縱隊迂迴迫使其撤離。次日莫羅南下，原本以為能逐退聯軍，9日卻在奧厄施泰特碰到韋羅特的前出部隊；法軍初戰奪取部分奧軍火炮，金策爾主力隨後抵達並扭轉局勢。當夜法軍繞到聯軍側翼，10日晨霧、霜雪與結冰地面妨礙炮車和馬匹調動，莫羅集中步兵攻擊奧軍側翼，迫使聯軍放棄陣位，帶著大量火炮、輜重及被俘官兵撤離霍恩林登。
tacticsEn: The war first reopened when Britain declared war on 18 May. Missiessy’s French squadron left Toulon later that month before the British blockade could be completed, and near Guadeloupe in early June it forced Duckworth’s divided British squadron away from a decisive engagement, preventing an immediate restoration of the British Caribbean blockade. On land, France did not commit every unit immediately to the front. Veterans were transferred from the English Channel coast toward the Rhine, the Netherlands, and southern Germany. Moreau established himself around Augsburg and Memmingen, Davout advanced from Hamburg through Münster, Kassel, and Fulda toward Würzburg, Ney exerted pressure in Tyrol, and Mortier moved toward Austria. The coalition intended to restore Hanover, send an Austrian army from Bohemia into Bavaria, and unite it with the Russians, but the roads and winter weather between Bohemia, Salzburg, and the Danube prevented those columns from arriving together. On 14 September, Ney defeated Austrian troops at Eger, while the Duke of Cambridge was forced back across the Elbe after the action at Lüneburg Heath. On 11 November, Mortier’s division under Eblé crossed the Danube at Artstetten and entered Lower Austria, forcing Kutaisov’s Russians and Der Plönnl’s Austrians toward Dürenstein and the nearby hills. Separate allied routes allowed part of their force to escape before Mortier could close the trap. On 2 December, Davout blocked Bagration’s column at Loigny, while Weyrother’s flanking movement from Auerstädt failed. At Zabern on 6 December, the coalition still offered a strong frontage from the heights, but Davout used frontal pressure and column movement to force its withdrawal. Moreau moved south on 7 December expecting to drive the allies away. On the 9th he encountered Weyrother’s advanced force at Auerstädt and initially captured Austrian guns, but Kienzl arrived with the main Austrian army and reversed the situation. During the night French troops turned the allied flank. On the morning of the 10th, fog, frost, snow, and frozen ground hindered caissons and horse teams. Moreau concentrated his infantry against the Austrian flank, compelling the coalition to leave its positions at Hohenlinden with guns, baggage, and many prisoners.
data: 1803年度的關鍵日期依次是：5月18日英國對法宣戰，8月24日法國對奧地利宣戰，9月14日埃格與呂訥堡荒原兩地作戰，11月11日迪倫施泰因戰役，12月2日盧瓦尼戰役，12月6日察貝恩戰役，12月9日至10日霍恩林登戰役，12月12日法奧停戰。常見兵力估計把迪倫施泰因的法軍列為約一萬八千人、俄奧聯軍約一萬一千人；盧瓦尼的法軍約二萬二千人、聯軍約二萬五千人；霍恩林登的法軍約二萬二千人、聯軍約三萬或稍多。兵力數字來自不同戰史與名冊整理，應視為約數，不宜視為開戰當日逐營點名。各軍主軸線也很清楚：達武由漢堡經明斯特、卡塞爾、富爾達南下至烏爾茨堡，聯軍主力由波希米亞進入上奧地利再向西，莫羅則依托奧格斯堡、明根及巴伐利亞北部配置。12月初雪地、泥路與低溫顯著拖慢補給車隊。傷亡統計因陣亡、負傷、失聯及投降名冊保存程度不同而常有差異，因此本文不把任何單一估計寫成精確傷亡總數。
dataEn: The principal dates of the 1803 campaign were 18 May for Britain’s declaration of war, 24 August for France’s declaration against Austria, 14 September for the actions at Eger and Lüneburg Heath, 11 November for Dürenstein, 2 December for Loigny, 6 December for Zabern, 9 and 10 December for Hohenlinden, and 12 December for the Franco-Austrian armistice. Common strength estimates place about 18,000 French troops against roughly 11,000 Russian and Austrian troops at Dürenstein. At Loigny, approximately 22,000 French troops faced about 25,000 coalition troops, while at Hohenlinden roughly 22,000 French troops confronted around 30,000 or slightly more allied troops. These figures come from different campaign histories and surviving returns and should be treated as estimates rather than exact company-by-company counts on the morning of battle. The routes of movement are equally clear. Davout advanced from Hamburg through Münster, Kassel, and Fulda toward Würzburg. The main coalition force entered Upper Austria from Bohemia and then moved west, while Moreau based himself around Augsburg, Memmingen, and northern Bavaria. Snow, mud, and low temperatures substantially delayed supply columns in early December. Casualty totals differ because records of killed, wounded, missing, and captured were preserved unevenly, so no single estimate is presented here as a precise total.
cause: 直接背景是1802年的《亞眠和約》只提供短期停戰，英法在海外基地、馬耳他、荷蘭軍隊及歐陸權力安排上仍無長期協議。巴黎要求倫敦承認法國對低地國家的重整及既有義大利安排，並把馬耳他交還聖約翰騎士團；英國則要求法國削弱荷蘭軍力，停止進一步擴張受法國影響的歐洲邦國，並維持英國的海上戰略地位。談判在1803年春破裂後，英國於5月先行宣戰。奧地利擔心法國控制萊茵與南德會削弱其戰略縱深，俄羅斯則希望以聯盟及英國補貼制衡法國；兩國在4月與英國訂立軍事和財政協議。瑞典與那不勒斯其後加入，普魯士雖接受接觸，仍拒絕承擔對法作戰義務。法國最後才對奧地利宣戰，使聯盟尚未完成共同計畫便進入戰略展開階段。
causeEn: The immediate background was the Treaty of Amiens of 1802, which provided only a temporary peace. Britain and France still lacked a lasting settlement over overseas bases, Malta, the Dutch army, and the balance of power on the continent. Paris wanted London to recognize France’s reorganization of the Low Countries and its existing Italian arrangements, together with the transfer of Malta to the Knights of St John. Britain required France to reduce Dutch military power, halt any further expansion among European states under French influence, and preserve Britain’s strategic maritime position. When negotiations broke down in the spring of 1803, Britain declared war first in May. Austria feared that French control of the Rhine and southern Germany would undermine its strategic depth, while Russia sought to use the alliance and British subsidies to contain France. Both concluded military and financial agreements with Britain in April. Sweden and Naples joined later, while Prussia accepted diplomatic contacts but refused the obligation to fight France. France declared war on Austria only after the coalition had begun to unfold, leaving the alliance to enter active operations before its common plan had been completed.
impact: 1803年最具決定性的後果，是法軍奪回對荷蘭、漢諾威、巴伐利亞及南德主要道路的軍事控制。巴伐利亞在聯軍尚未集中前便停止對法國的抵抗，符騰堡與巴登則更牢固地留在法國陣營，萊茵邦聯的安全從此更依賴巴黎。聯軍原想讓奧軍、俄軍、漢諾威軍與蒂羅爾部隊會合，結果每一支縱隊都可被法軍單獨擊退或繞過。蘇聯在上奥地利與巴伐利亚方向的攻勢在乌爾茨堡、盧瓦尼和霍恩林登连续受挫，奥地利被迫停战，俄罗斯主力也失去继续维持南欧攻势的支柱。普鲁士保持中立，使法国东部边界没有出现新的 Coalition 战场，而英国仍須依靠海上封锁和财政补贴维持战争。法軍的分散調度顯示，各軍團不必时时集中，只要在戰略目標與交通線上相互配合，仍能取得局部優勢；但莫羅未能徹底消滅迪倫施泰因的俄軍，顯示遠距離追擊、封閉退路及冬季後勤仍是弱點。
impactEn: The most decisive result of 1803 was the recovery by France of military control over the Netherlands, Hanover, Bavaria, and the principal roads of southern Germany. Bavaria stopped resisting France before the coalition could concentrate, while Württemberg and Baden became more firmly established within the French orbit, making the security of the Rhine Confederation increasingly dependent on Paris. The coalition had intended to unite Austrian, Russian, Hanoverian, and Tyrolean forces, but each column could be defeated or bypassed separately. The allied thrust through Upper Austria and Bavaria was checked at Würzburg, Loigny, and Hohenlinden. Austria was compelled into an armistice, Russia lost the support needed to continue a southern campaign, Prussian neutrality denied France a new coalition front in the east, and Britain remained dependent on maritime blockade and foreign subsidies. The French dispersion of forces demonstrated that corps did not need to remain in permanent close concentration if their strategic objectives and lines of communication were coordinated. At the same time, Moreau’s failure to destroy the Russian force at Dürenstein exposed continuing weaknesses in long-range pursuit, control of escape routes, and winter logistics.
result: 霍恩林登的結果使聯盟失去整個南德戰役的主動權。巴伐利亞已於12月2日先行停戰，奧地利聯軍則在10日敗退後放棄大部分火炮與輜重，並於12月12日同法國簽訂停戰；奧軍停止本戰役年度的攻勢，聯軍在南德的縱隊不再能相互掩護。法國取得的是一個明確的戰役年度優勢，而不是全歐和平。英國對法戰爭仍在海上和殖民地戰線繼續，瑞典與俄羅斯也可依自身利益繼續或中止軍事行動，因此不能把12月停戰視為第三次反法同盟整體戰爭的終局。本文記錄止於1803年12月；聯盟整體仍延續到1805年，其最終局面並不屬於這段1803年戰役實錄。
resultEn: The outcome at Hohenlinden deprived the coalition of initiative throughout the southern German theater. Bavaria had already concluded an armistice on 2 December, and after the allied defeat on the 10th the Austrian army abandoned much of its artillery and baggage before signing an armistice with France on 12 December. Austrian offensive operations for the campaign year ended, and coalition columns in southern Germany could no longer support one another. France had gained a decisive advantage for the 1803 campaign year, but this was not a general European peace. Britain’s war with France continued at sea and across overseas theaters, while Sweden and Russia remained free to continue or terminate their own operations according to their interests. The December armistice therefore cannot be treated as the final conclusion of the Third Coalition as a whole. This account ends in December 1803; the wider coalition war continued into 1805, and its final outcome lies outside the scope of this campaign record.
